critique: The interplay between the canvas-drawn pastel gears, the smooth SVG pendulum, and the animated CSS "melt" drips successfully creates a mesmerizing, Dali-esque cyber-clockwork atmosphere. However, the inclusion of an external raster image (`guineapig.png`) breaks the self-contained generative purity; replacing it with a procedurally coded, glowing organic form would better achieve a true cyber-nature fusion.
